Package com.saicone.types.parser

Class PatternAnnotatedParser

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.PatternParser
com.saicone.types.parser.PatternAnnotatedParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnotatedTypeParser<Pattern>, TypeParser<Pattern>, Function<Object,Pattern>
public class PatternAnnotatedParser extends PatternParser implements AnnotatedTypeParser<Pattern>
Represents a parser that try to convert any String representation of Pattern, compatible with any type annotated with PatternFlags.
